projects.name: Concurrent Limit Order Matching Engines
bullets: Built concurrent C++20 and Go limit-order matching engines supporting Unix-socket client ingestion, per-instrument order books, buy/sell/cancel commands, and add/execute/cancel output semantics.
Implemented price-time priority matching with FIFO tie-breaking, partial/full fills, multi-order execution, residual booking, resting-price trades, and execution IDs.

Designed concurrent order processing using per-instrument sharding, fine-grained synchronization in C++, and goroutine/channel-based routing in Go; verified correctness with grader fixtures and multi-client stress inputs.
